description: Retele de transport feroviar - serviciu descarcare is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.infofer.ro. Serviciu de descarcare pentru date spatiale aferente temei INSPIRE - Retele de transport Feroviar ce reprezinta reteaua de linii CF aflate in administrarea Companiei Nationale de Cai Ferate CFR SA. Coverage: RO. Its keywords include national. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
